verdict.rationale: Buzz's own agents can search six months of workspace history and post the relevant threads back into channels. They respond to @mentions inside the product, and a bundled managed agent plus the buzz-agent runtime provide the AI layer, so you can get AI-derived answers from your data in the product. However, the evidence frames this as on-demand agent replies, and you supply the LLM provider; there is no documented proactive insight or suggestion feature. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic insight and suggestion surfacing, analytics or summarization over workspace data beyond search-and-post, built-in model without bring-your-own provider, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
